centre: Set the polar origin in pixels where 0,0 is the layer centre.
radius: Set the outer radius as a percentage of the shortest layer dimension.
innerRadius: Offset the mapping away from the pole by skipping a given percentage of the radius.
angleOffset: Rotate the polar conversion in degrees.
angularRange: Limit the conversion to a wedge of the circle in degrees.
invertRadius: Flip the mapping so the bottom of the source becomes the outer edge and the top maps to the pole.
edgeFeather: Feather width in pixels applied to the inner and outer circular edges.
seamFeather: Feather width in degrees applied to the angular seam.
